query: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, ou.organizationId, o.name as org_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN organization_users ou ON u.id = ou.userId LEFT JOIN organizations o ON ou.organizationId = o.id WHERE u.email LIKE '%@%' ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT 10;
